changes.evidence: At the end of Thunderbolts*, Valentina presents the team as the New Avengers. They go along with it, and 14 months later in the post-credits scene they are still the New Avengers. Nothing moves Walker back to 'The Thunderbolts', so the last stage is wrong. The MCU wiki lists his current affiliation as New Avengers, and his hero file A:john-walker already ends on New Avengers.

In Black Panther, Killmonger wins the throne in ritual combat and is King of Wakanda until he dies fighting T'Challa. He never goes back to the U.S. military, which the MCU wiki lists only as a former affiliation (U.S. Navy/SEALs, formerly; Golden Tribe, Tribal Council). The last 'U.S. Military' stage is wrong.

In Doctor Strange, Kaecilius is a former Master of Kamar-Taj who lost faith in the Ancient One and then led the Zealots. He was never a Zealot before he was a Master. In story order it is Masters, then Zealots. The MCU wiki lists Masters of the Mystic Arts (formerly), then Zealots.

Minn-Erva is a Starforce member through all of Captain Marvel and dies as one: Yon-Rogg sends her after the Quadjet, and Maria Rambeau shoots her down. Nothing moves her out of Starforce, so the last 'Kree Empire' stage is wrong. The MCU wiki lists Starforce as her affiliation.

In Captain Marvel, Korath stays in Starforce through the battle at Mar-Vell's lab. He leaves Starforce only off screen, in tie-in material, before Guardians of the Galaxy, where he serves Ronan. No move back to the Kree Empire happens in Captain Marvel. The MCU wiki lists Starforce (formerly).

Thor: The Dark World: Loki is imprisoned in Asgard, fights for it beside Thor on Svartalfheim, then rules it disguised as Odin (MCU wiki section 'King of Asgard'). That is a move out of the Chitauri and back into Asgard, and no stage records it. Thor: Ragnarok: after the Revengers' battle he rejoins Asgard's people as they flee, and he is on the Asgardian refugee ship in Infinity War. The MCU wiki lists Asgard as current and Revengers as former. The hero file A:loki already has Asgard at The Dark World and again at the end of Ragnarok.

Deadpool & Wolverine: Ladypool is a Deadpool variant that the TVA pruned to the Void, where she joins Cassandra Nova's Deadpool Corps. She is not from Earth-199999. Marvel Database files her as Wanda Wilson (Earth-TRN872), the same designation proposed for Nicepool.

owner_calls.question: Should Walker join Valentina's outfit (O.X.E. Group) in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, when she recruits him, instead of in Thunderbolts*?
options: Keep O.X.E. Group from Thunderbolts* (O.X.E. is first named there)
Add an O.X.E. Group stage at The Falcon and the Winter Soldier (episode 6, when Val gives him the U.S. Agent suit)
owner_calls.evidence: In episode 5, Val approaches the discharged Walker and gives him her card. In episode 6, she gives him a black suit and names him U.S. Agent. O.X.E. as her organization is named only in Thunderbolts*. The MCU wiki lists O.X.E. as a former affiliation.

owner_calls.question: Does B-15's rebellion in Loki S1 count as turning on the TVA (a move out, then back in within S1), or as staying inside the TVA?
options: [The TVA, (from the start)], [Independent, Loki S1], [The TVA, Loki S1]
owner_calls.evidence: In Loki S1 episode 4, B-15 frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber and is taken into custody 'for her rebellion'. In episode 6, Mobius frees her, and she tells the Minutemen the truth and orders a halt to pruning from inside the TVA, which she helps run in S2. Either way, she ends in the TVA.

owner_calls.question: Does Miss Minutes' work with Renslayer against the TVA in Loki S2 count as turning on the TVA?
options: [The TVA, (from the start)], [Independent, Loki S2], [The TVA, Loki S2]
owner_calls.evidence: In Loki S2 episodes 3 and 4, she works with Renslayer to retake the TVA for He Who Remains' plan and crushes Dox's loyalists, and O.B.'s reboot shuts her down. In episode 6, Ouroboros reprograms and reboots her, and she goes back to running TVA systems. Either way, she ends in the TVA.
